title: 小型ホイールローダー
description: 建設区画や公園整備の資材置場に配置する小型ホイールローダー。太い四輪、前後分割車体と中央関節、オープンキャノピーの着座運転席、側面二段ステップを備えます。低い左右一対のリフトアーム、支持塔、昇降シリンダーと中央Zバー風チルトリンクが、空洞の幅広バケットと刃先へ接続。後部フード、グリル、車軸、フェンダー、底面部材も造形。掘削機のブームやフォークとは異なる一式1モデルです。荷物はなく、走行・関節・積込・油圧動作、荷重・実機性能・安全性は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.710 × 2.416 × 4.080 m、50,712三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A compact wheel-loader prop for construction compounds and park-maintenance material yards. Four large tires flank front and rear chassis halves with a central articulation joint. An open-canopy seated station has two-level side entry steps. Paired low lift arms, support towers, lift cylinders and a central Z-bar-style tilt linkage connect to a broad hollow bucket and cutting edge, distinct from an excavator boom or forks. Rear hood, grille, axles, fenders and underside members complete one whole assembly counted once. No cargo, driving, articulation, loading or hydraulic operation, load rating, real-machine performance or safety validation is supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.710 × 2.416 × 4.080 m; 50,712 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
